claims.claim: Route2Look achieves 75.4% on LVBench with only 202.3 frames, outperforming DVD by 1.2% while using only 2.5% of its frames.
Learned routing with differential contrastive analysis achieves 70.0% compared to 61.5% without it and 66.5% for heuristic routing.
Oracle routing achieves 81.5% accuracy with 131.8 frames.
Held-out domain routing achieves 74.2% on Sport and 59.4% on TV, outperforming single-strategy baselines.
